gravis_flying_config_menu.screen.title: Create Fly Config
gravis_flying_config_menu.screen.empty: No configs found. Is Create Fly installed and compatible?
gravis_flying_config_menu.restart.client: Needs a game restart to take full effect.
gravis_flying_config_menu.restart.server: Needs a world or server restart to take full effect.
gravis_flying_config_menu.restart.both: Needs a restart to take full effect.
gravis_flying_config_menu.relog: Rejoin the world for this to take effect.
gravis_flying_config_menu.ui.client.tool: Settings that only change your own game: visuals, interface and tooltips.
gravis_flying_config_menu.ui.common.tool: Settings read when the game starts and shared by every world. Many need a restart.
gravis_flying_config_menu.ui.server.tool: Settings of the world you play in: machines, recipes, kinetics. Saved in the server settings file.
gravis_flying_config_menu.ui.no_config: This mod has no config of this kind.
gravis_flying_config_menu.ui.go_back.too: Goes up one page, or back to the previous screen. Asks first if you have unsaved changes.
gravis_flying_config_menu.ui.save.toolti: Writes every change you made to the config file.
gravis_flying_config_menu.ui.discard.too: Throws away the changes you have not saved yet.
gravis_flying_config_menu.ui.reset_all.t: Puts every option of this file back to its default. Nothing is written until you save.
gravis_flying_config_menu.ui.resetting_m: Put every option of the %s config back to its default? Nothing is saved until you press Save.
gravis_flying_config_menu.ui.saving_mess: Save %s changed option(s) to the config file?
gravis_flying_config_menu.ui.leaving_mes: You have %s unsaved change(s). Save them before leaving?
gravis_flying_config_menu.ui.server_lock: You are connected to a server, so you can see its settings but not change them from here.
